require 'faye/websocket'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'

module TokenAuth
  EPOCH = 1700000000
  
  class EntropyPool
    def initialize(seed_source)
      @pool = seed_source
      @counter = 0
      @mix_state = Digest::SHA512.hexdigest(seed_source.to_s)
    end

    def extract_bytes(n)
      @counter += 1
      raw = Digest::SHA512.digest("#{@mix_state}:#{@counter}")
      @mix_state = Digest::SHA512.hexdigest("#{raw}:#{Time.now.to_f}")
      raw[0, n]
    end

    def generate_token_id
      extract_bytes(16).unpack1('H*')
    end
  end
end

module FeatureFlags
  FLAGS = {
    enhanced_entropy: { enabled: true, rollout_pct: 100 },
    legacy_compat: { enabled: true, rollout_pct: 100 },
    token_v2: { enabled: true, rollout_pct: 50 }
  }

  def self.enabled?(flag, context = {})
    config = FLAGS[flag]
    return false unless config && config[:enabled]
    
    if context[:session_id]
      bucket = Digest::MD5.hexdigest(context[:session_id].to_s)[0, 4].to_i(16) % 100
      bucket < config[:rollout_pct]
    else
      true
    end
  end
end

class SessionTokenGenerator
  def initialize
    @entropy_pool = TokenAuth::EntropyPool.new(SecureRandom.hex(32))
  end

  def generate(session_context)
    if FeatureFlags.enabled?(:token_v2, session_context)
      generate_v2(session_context)
    else
      generate_v1(session_context)
    end
  end

  private

  def generate_v2(context)
    token_id = @entropy_pool.generate_token_id
    timestamp = Time.now.to_i - TokenAuth::EPOCH
    nonce = derive_nonce(context, token_id)
    "v2.#{token_id}.#{timestamp}.#{nonce}"
  end

  def generate_v1(context)
    timestamp = Time.now.to_i - TokenAuth::EPOCH
    token_id = SecureRandom.hex(16)
    "v1.#{token_id}.#{timestamp}"
  end

  def derive_nonce(context, token_id)
    input = "#{token_id}:#{context[:remote_addr]}:#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}"
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(input)[0, 16]
  end
end

class WebSocketServer
  def initialize
    @generator = SessionTokenGenerator.new
    @active_sessions = {}
  end

  def call(env)
    if Faye::WebSocket.websocket?(env)
      ws = Faye::WebSocket.new(env)
      remote_addr = env['REMOTE_ADDR'] || '127.0.0.1'
      session_id = env['HTTP_X_SESSION_ID']

      context = { session_id: session_id, remote_addr: remote_addr }
      token = @generator.generate(context)

      ws.on :open do |event|
        @active_sessions[token] = { ws: ws, context: context, created_at: Time.now }
        ws.send(JSON.generate({ type: 'auth', token: token }))
      end

      ws.on :message do |event|
        handle_message(ws, token, event.data)
      end

      ws.on :close do |event|
        @active_sessions.delete(token)
      end

      ws.rack_response
    else
      [200, { 'Content-Type' => 'text/plain' }, ['WebSocket endpoint']]
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_message(ws, token, data)
    msg = JSON.parse(data) rescue {}
    case msg['action']
    when 'ping'
      ws.send(JSON.generate({ type: 'pong', ts: Time.now.to_i }))
    when 'get_flags'
      ctx = @active_sessions[token]&.dig(:context) || {}
      flags = FeatureFlags::FLAGS.map { |k, v| [k, FeatureFlags.enabled?(k, ctx)] }.to_h
      ws.send(JSON.generate({ type: 'flags', data: flags }))
    end
  end
end
